summary: Tested all 4 P0 features (Currently Reading tracker, Like toggle + /likes, Clickable/Editable Author + /author/:name, Select All checklist) end-to-end. 14 of 15 requested behaviors verified. Backend 8/9 pytest passing; 1 minor issue with legacy readings lacking new default fields. Frontend all UI flows working correctly (progress ring, pink heart #FF2A79, status toggle with auto-complete logic present, author navigation without triggering row nav, Select All / Deselect All fully functional with 4 seeded checklist items).

minor.issue: Legacy readings created before schema update do not include status/total_pages/pages_read/liked keys in the response (they were never set in MongoDB and are not defaulted at read-time). Newly created readings correctly include all fields. Frontend currently uses `r.status === 'reading'` fallback checks, so this doesn't visibly break the UI, but strict schema consumers may miss keys. Consider defaulting missing fields to null on GET, or running a one-time migration.

issues: Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' on LogReadingDialog. Non-blocking a11y warning from Radix.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Backend — normalize legacy readings via one-time migration OR add defaults in `list_readings`/`get_reading` responses so `status`, `total_pages`, `pages_read`, `liked` are always present.
OPTIONAL: Add DialogDescription to LogReadingDialog for a11y (Radix warning).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py `update_reading` uses `{k: v for k, v in upd.model_dump().items() if v is not None}` — this means PATCHing `liked=false` gets filtered out, but here it still works because Pydantic ReadingUpdate has liked: Optional[bool]=None and the frontend sends liked=false explicitly. However this pattern will silently drop legitimate `false`/`0` payloads if `liked`/`pages_read` need to be reset. Consider using explicit `exclude_unset=True` or checking for `is None` differently.

ReadingDetailPage.jsx line 250-266: pages inputs use local state without debounce — every keystroke sets local state but only PATCHes onBlur. Works fine but consider explicit save button or debounce for clarity.
toggleSelectAll runs N parallel PATCH requests (one per item). Fine for small lists but O(N) network fan-out — could be a single bulk endpoint later.

success_rate.backend: 89% (8/9 pytest); all P0 create/patch endpoints work

seed_data_creation: Created 2 test readings (UITEST_CurrentlyReading with status=reading, total_pages=200, pages_read=45; UITEST_CompletedBook status=completed) both by author 'UITEST_AuthorX'. Seeded 4 checklist items via direct mongo insert to test Select All (AI generation blocked by budget). All test data cleaned up at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI endpoints (/checklist/generate, /notes/generate, /quiz/generate, /cover/generate, /highlights/suggest) remain blocked by 'Budget exceeded' — do not test them. For Select All UI, seed checklist rows directly in mongo since generation fails. Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_p0_features.py covers the 4 P0 features end-to-end.
